name: War-shattered charred pine stump
description: A Scots pine stump shattered by artillery / fire: charred black exterior, exposed pale-wood shatter face with concentric rings, three jagged splinters projecting from the break, and a disturbed-soil base disc. charBlack shell / woodMid–woodDark shatter face / barkPine bark splinter.

parts.name: Char / disturbed-soil ground disc
parts.note: r=360 mm, h=18 mm; bottom at y=0.000. Widest part — sets footprint w/d=0.72.

parts.name: Root flare — charred wider tapered base zone
parts.note: r=310 mm at base, r2=250 mm at top; bottom at y=0.000. Charred per war_forests; tapers to trunk radius.

parts.name: Main charred stump trunk cylinder
parts.note: r=250 mm, h=650 mm; bottom at y=0.000, top at y=0.650. Fully charred exterior — 'black stick' silhouette.

parts.name: Left longitudinal char-streak / burn groove
parts.note: Centre at x=−0.22; outer face at x=−0.25 flush with cylinder surface — curved vs flat, no coplanar z-fight. Reads as deep longitudinal fire groove on bark.

parts.name: Outer sapwood ring at shatter face
parts.note: r=230 mm (92% of trunk_r); bottom at y=0.650 = trunk_body top (opposite-normal contact, safe). Pale exposed sapwood ring.

parts.name: Latewood ring at shatter face
parts.note: r=150 mm; bottom at y=0.662 = break_wood_outer top (opposite-normal, safe). Darker latewood annual band.

parts.name: Charred heartwood core at shatter face
parts.note: r=60 mm; bottom at y=0.674 = break_wood_mid top (opposite-normal, safe). Burned heartwood reads as a dark bull's-eye at the centre of the break face.

parts.name: Largest splintered shard — leans +x / +z
parts.note: Centre at y=0.72; unrotated bottom y=0.61 (embedded ~40 mm below break for structural read). Estimated rotated top ≈ y=0.837. Pale inner wood exposed by impact.

parts.name: Mid splintered shard — leans -x / +z (still barked)
parts.note: Still-barked outer splinter. Estimated rotated top ≈ y=0.796.

parts.name: Small splintered shard — leans +x / -z
parts.note: Latewood-side darker shard. Estimated rotated top ≈ y=0.755.
